description:
Update a workflow public form link, including enabling/disabling it, limits, auto-share, expiry, and success message.

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

autoShare.description: Whether to show generated results inline after completion.

enabled.description: Whether the public form link is enabled. Defaults to true on create.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO datetime after which the form link expires.

shareExpiresInDays.description: Optional number of days before inline result shares expire.

successMessage.description: Optional thank-you message shown after submission.

name: update_public_form_link
